name: Claim with no commercial basis or prior trading history
description: The legal claim rests on a contract, service or loss that lacks supporting commercial evidence, a trading history between the parties, or a plausible amount in relation to the stated losses.
fp: Early-stage claims may be thinly evidenced and some disputes are about informal deals. Corroborate with counterparties or independent records.

links.name: Claim with no commercial basis or prior trading history
links.ctx: Helps separate a genuine though weak dispute from a fabricated one.
